name: seal-verify
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,datetime
p=Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def put(n,v):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
m=json.loads(Path('manifest.json').read_text())
for n,v in m['files'].items():assert h((p/n).read_bytes())==v['sha256']
expected='04dd75b46e30b898a545e6dec21b643148804357bafee8f711be8fc3b8eab094';assert h(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected==Path('reservation.sha256').read_text().strip()
exclude={'final-manifest.json':'self-referential hash impossible','final-verification.json':'verification written after final manifest','seal-verify.receipt.json':'receipt not complete until this runner exits','seal-verify.output.txt':'output not complete until this runner exits'}
files={str(f.relative_to(p)):{'bytes':f.stat().st_size,'sha256':h(f.read_bytes())} for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and str(f.relative_to(p)) not in exclude}
completed_receipts=[n for n in files if n.endswith('.receipt.json')]
assert 'post-handback-audit.receipt.json' in completed_receipts
put('final-manifest.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'files':files,'completed_receipt_JSONs':completed_receipts,'explicit_noncircular_self_exclusions':exclude,'scope':'Own lane only; every other current file included, no protected lane traversal'})
sealed=json.loads(Path('final-manifest.json').read_text())
for n,v in sealed['files'].items():assert h((p/n).read_bytes())==v['sha256'] and (p/n).stat().st_size==v['bytes']
assert len(json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text()))==20
put('final-verification.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'pass':True,'final_manifest_sha256':h(Path('final-manifest.json').read_bytes()),'files_verified':len(files),'completed_receipt_JSONs_verified':len(completed_receipts),'reservation_after_handback_sha256':expected,'exact_dispositions':20,'credit':0,'campaign':'52/60 unchanged','all_prior_jobs_reaped':True,'terminal_runner':'seal-verify is synchronous and reaps its child and writers before returning; its own receipt/output are named self-exclusions','no_formal_or_acceptance_claim':True})
print(json.dumps({'PASS':True,'files_verified':len(files),'completed_receipt_JSONs_verified':len(completed_receipts),'reservation':expected,'records':20,'credit':0,'campaign':'52/60 unchanged'}))
